557:t_010:7.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I can't believe... the spear is in this world.」

557:t_010:8.en:
$$カヲル$$
「It seems he was using it to forcibly distort space-time.」

557:t_010:9.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't really get it, but he was going to use that spear, a $$時空震動弾$$, and $$かなめ$$'s power for $$時空修復$$?」

557:t_010:10.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then does that mean his plan's ruined now!?」

557:t_010:11.en:
$$オルソン$$
「No. The dimensional boundary is still being distorted!」

557:t_011:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$!」

557:t_011:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「I didn't expect to lose the spear, but it has already served its purpose.」

557:t_011:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「The plan will move to phase two. Next, we'll release Iota waves and have over eighty percent of the world's people die.」

557:t_011:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「Surely you understand? For $$時空修復$$.」

557:t_011:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Why does that require taking people's lives!?」

557:t_011:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「It seems you didn't know. To remake the world according to one person's will... In other words, to force $$時空修復$$...」

557:t_011:8.en:
$$レナード$$
「You have to reduce resistance from the power of life as much as possible.」

557:t_011:11.en:
$$キラ$$
「That's... something every living person has...」

557:t_011:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「You could say the power of life is the very force that seeks to exist.」

557:t_011:13.en:
$$レナード$$
「If it rejects a change to the natural order, even $$次元力$$ can't control events.」

557:t_011:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And for that, you'll take the lives of people who know nothing of this!?」

557:t_011:15.en:
$$レナード$$
「The $$時空修復$$ during the $$多元戦争$$ and $$時獄戦役$$ gathered the will of nearly everyone in the world... They wouldn't have needed this.」

557:t_011:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「But there's no need to worry. Those who die will surely live different lives in a world other than this one.」

557:t_011:18.en:
$$万丈$$
「It seems this won't end with just one more parallel world.」

557:t_011:19.en:
$$タケル$$
「You'll destroy this world to bring a new one into being!?」

557:t_011:20.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$レナード$$... Do you think we would accept such a thing?」

557:t_011:21.en:
$$レナード$$
「I never intended to ask for your permission.」

557:t_011:22.en:
$$葵$$
「But you've made a fatal mistake. One that's common among people who look down on others.」

557:t_011:23.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Don't think we'll let you go after hearing your plan to take people's lives.」

557:t_011:24.en:
$$レナード$$
「Didn't this possibility occur to you?」

557:t_011:25.en:
$$レナード$$
「That losing has never even crossed my mind.」

557:t_012:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「There are so many giant ASes!」

557:t_012:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「There's more than thirty of them!」

557:t_012:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Can you win after wearing yourselves out in successive battles and fighting the Angels?」

557:t_012:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「At the very least, breaking through them will take you a considerable amount of time.」

557:t_012:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...So this is your trump card, $$レナード$$...」

557:t_012:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「Will you raise the white flag, $$テレサ$$?」

557:t_012:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If you think we brought one here, you're sorely mistaken! ...$$相良$$!」

557:t_013:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「A suicide charge... That's an uncharacteristic tactic.」

557:t_013:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We have no intention of making a reckless gamble or throwing our lives away!」

557:t_013:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Let's do it, $$アル$$! $$妖精の羽$$!」

557:t_014:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ミラ$$'s new equipment, $$妖精の羽$$... It temporarily disables every $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ within range, including our own...」

557:t_014:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「The opposite image from when I use the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$...」

557:t_014:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ is a sham, a fraud, a hoax! Supernatural phenomena like that can't happen!」

557:t_015:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We did it! With their $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$s gone, those big bastards couldn't support their own weight and bit the dust!」

557:t_015:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「Who'd have thought your old hatred of the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ would come in handy here?」

557:t_015:2.en:
$$アル$$
「Success. Your stubborn realism has turned the situation around, Sergeant.」

557:t_015:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Can you hear me, $$千鳥$$!? I've come to bring you back!」

557:t_015:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
($$宗介$$...? I know I shot him dead myself... What's going on...?)

557:t_015:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「...I tried to think of some gentle words, but I'm still the same man I've always been.」

557:t_015:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「I can only speak bluntly. So listen closely. What I want to say is...」

557:t_015:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「I thought you were a woman with more guts than this. Do you understand?」

557:t_015:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
(What is he saying, after all this...?)

557:t_015:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll be honest, $$千鳥かなめ$$. I'm disappointed in you. I thought you were a more remarkable woman.」

557:t_015:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「No, wait... That's not accurate, either. In truth, you've often pissed me off, even back then.」

557:t_015:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「You kept hitting my head and wouldn't allow a calm discussion. Sometimes I seethed, wondering if you were controlling me by feeding me.」

557:t_015:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「You showed no consideration for poor me, who'd never known a peaceful life.」

557:t_015:15.en:
$$宗介$$
「Looking back, that wasn't fair. You're a horrible person.」

557:t_015:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「No... That isn't important. It just occurred to me, so I mentioned it while I was at it.」

557:t_015:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Anyway, what I'm asking is whether you're a woman worth throwing everything away to rescue.」

557:t_015:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「I was so close in $$ニケーロ$$ and $$ヤムスク１１$$, but couldn't rescue you because you dawdled. Honestly... What kind of princess are you?」

557:t_015:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「Are you actually not even trying? You don't really care, do you?」

557:t_015:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「Will you start sniveling because I said this? Like some stupid woman waiting for some stupid man to comfort her?」

557:t_015:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
(That man would never chatter this much. He's trying to shake me up, but I won't fall for it.)

557:t_015:26.en:
$$宗介$$
「What do you mean, 'Let's go home together'? You're a filthy lying bitch!」

557:t_015:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you say I'm wrong, come hit me! Smack my head with a slipper or a paper fan!」

557:t_015:28.en:
$$かなめ$$
(What the hell...? I feel sick...)
